specialistWarning.name: Specialist Bias
specialistWarning.desc: Pick rate is low (<3% PR). Metrics are highly subject to one-trick specialist bias.

highlyContested.name: Highly Contested
highlyContested.desc: The most feared characters in the current patch. They dictate the draft and are either instantly banned or desperately first-picked.

snowballer.name: Snowballer
snowballer.desc: Unstoppable if picked first to set the game's pace, but falls apart if drafted late when the enemy can react.

wingman.name: The Wingman
wingman.desc: A highly reliable, safe early pick that forms the backbone of a draft and resists being easily countered.

draftTrap.name: Draft Trap
draftTrap.desc: Players mistakenly prioritize this character early out of habit, but they perform poorly when blind-picked and easily lose games.

noobTrap.name: Noob Trap
noobTrap.desc: A flashy, commonly played character that mathematically handicaps the team. Opponents intentionally leave them unbanned.

corePick.name: Core Pick
corePick.desc: A stable, essential character stashed in the unbannable Slot 3 to guarantee the team's overarching strategy succeeds.

trollPick.name: Troll Pick
trollPick.desc: Wasting the team's only safe, unbannable slot on a mathematically doomed character, often indicating a tilted or griefing player.

clutcher.name: Clutcher
clutcher.desc: A devastating late pick that panics opponents into post-bans and single-handedly wins games if let through the draft.

pocketPick.name: Pocket Pick
pocketPick.desc: A highly specialized, unpopular character that dramatically overperforms when brought out specifically as a late-draft surprise.

failedCounter.name: Failed Counter
failedCounter.desc: Picked late specifically to counter the enemy team, but mechanically fails at the job, resulting in a disastrous win rate.

decoy.name: The Decoy
decoy.desc: A character that scares players into wasting bans despite having a poor win rate. Banning them is mathematically a mistake.

hiddenGem.name: Hidden Gem
hiddenGem.desc: A completely ignored character that flies under the radar of both picks and bans, yet boasts an absurdly high win rate.

flexPick.name: Flex Pick
flexPick.desc: A highly versatile character drafted evenly across all phases, giving zero strategic clues to the enemy team.

deadMeta.name: Dead Meta
deadMeta.desc: An entirely abandoned character with abysmal stats. They essentially do not exist in the current competitive meta.

standardDraft.name: Standard Draft
standardDraft.desc: Draft statistics show standard placement distributions with no extreme slot or performance biases in the current meta.
